analyses.nonInferiorityComment: The null (H0) hypothesis and the alternative (Ha) hypothesis to be tested for the primary efficacy endpoint are that H0: Δ = 0 versus Ha: Δ ≠ 0 where Δ is the true paired treatment difference between CDCA and placebo for the change from baseline in loge-transformed urine 23S-pentol in the adult cohort.

groups.description: Active: Contains 250 mg of Chenodiol (the non-proprietary name for CDCA). Open-label and blinded CDCA are the same drug product.
groups.title: CDCA TID

groups.description: Control: Placebo study medication is provided in the same form as blinded CDCA, as white film-coated 250-mg tablets with no CDCA.
groups.title: Placebo TID

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: All adult cohort participants who were randomized and took at least one dose of randomized study medication.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: Two double-blind periods: Week 0 to Week 4, Week 12 to Week 16
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline in Urine 23S-Pentol During the Two Double-Blind Periods
